definitions.explanation: the period of heavy traffic congestion when people return home from work, typically in the evening

examples.japanese: {帰宅|きたく}ラッシュ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{混|こ}んでいた→混む：02574_komu⟧。
examples.english: The train was crowded due to the evening rush.

examples.japanese: {帰宅|きたく}ラッシュ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}けて→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧⟦{遅|おそ}く→遅い：00533_osoi⟧⟦{帰|かえ}った→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: I went home late to avoid the evening rush.

examples.japanese: {金曜|きんよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{帰宅|きたく}ラッシュ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{特|とく}に→特に：01260_tokuni⟧⟦ひどい→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧。
examples.english: The Friday evening rush is especially bad.

notes:
COMPOUNDS:
⟦{帰宅|きたく}→帰宅：02546_kitaku⟧ (returning home) + ⟦ラッシュ→ラッシュ：11221_rasshu⟧ (rush, from English)

TIMING:
Typically refers to:
- 5:30-8:00 PM in major Japanese cities
- Often less concentrated than morning rush

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {帰宅|きたく}ラッシュ (evening rush) ↔ ⟦{通勤|つうきん}ラッシュ→通勤ラッシュ：08486_tsuukinrasshu⟧ (morning rush)
